🎭 KHAYALI DOCTOR – A Desi Comedy That Will Ilaaj Your Soul

Presented by The Dramatic Desi

📅 FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 13, 2026

🕖 Showtime: 7:00 PM

📍 The Grand | Ritz Theater – Escondido, CA

😂 A DESI COMEDY FULL OF CHAOS, FAMILY & BOLLYWOOD FUN!

Meet Rasiklal Mehta: convinced he's one sneeze from the grave and determined to marry off his daughter to keep a doctor in the family. There’s just one problem — she has other plans.

And then there’s Chameli, the governess quietly running the entire household while everyone else thinks they’re in charge.

Khayali Doctor reimagines Molière’s Le Malade Imaginaire as a colorful Desi comedy packed with mistaken identities, Bollywood parody numbers, family drama, and plenty of laughs.

Come find out who’s really sick in this house — and who’s just been pretending! 🎭
